nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Cincinnati. Noon our time, on Channel 4. The Saints have won three games and lost seven after losing at Chicago 21-13. Tight end Juwan Johnson will not play, and three more players may not either. Cincinnati has the best passing offense in the league.

news.headline: Three more Saints may miss Sunday's game
news.summary: Tight end Noah Fant, Taliese Fuaga and Asim Richards are all listed as a question mark for the game at Cincinnati. Juwan Johnson is already ruled out, so the Saints could be thin at tight end.

news.headline: Juwan Johnson is out for Sunday's game
news.summary: The Saints ruled the tight end out on Friday. He has a hurt hamstring and a hurt wrist and has not practiced all week. Center Erik McCoy is cleared to play.

news.headline: Erik McCoy practices full, Juwan Johnson still out
news.summary: The Saints center took a full practice on Thursday, his first since he hurt his biceps against Cleveland on November 8. Tight end Juwan Johnson missed practice again with a hurt hamstring and a hurt wrist, three days before the game at Cincinnati.

nextGame.label: Bowl game — not picked yet
nextGame.note: Florida finished the season with eight wins and four losses, so the Gators are going to a bowl game. Which bowl it is, and who they play, is announced on Sunday, December 6.

news.headline: Florida beats Florida State 26-10
news.summary: The Gators won Friday in Tallahassee to finish the regular season with eight wins and four losses. It is three wins in a row, and the third year in a row Florida has beaten Florida State.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh runs for 1,000 yards again
news.summary: Baugh ran for 77 yards and a touchdown against Florida State and finished the season with 1,057. He is the first Florida running back ever to run for 1,000 yards two years in a row.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is done for the season
news.summary: Florida said Tuesday that receiver Vernell Brown will have surgery on his right knee and will not play again this year. He hurt the knee against Ole Miss in late September and has missed the last seven games.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning road game in Fayetteville, Arkansas. A quarter to twelve our time, on the SEC Network. It is the last game of the regular season, and the winner keeps the Golden Boot, the trophy these two teams play for every year. LSU has won six games and lost five, and the Tigers have lost three in a row. Receiver Winston Watkins will not play. Arkansas has won four games and lost seven.

news.headline: Winston Watkins will not play at Arkansas
news.summary: LSU's second-leading receiver was ruled out Friday night for Saturday's game. He has 41 catches this season, and the Tigers had trouble throwing the ball without him last week at Tennessee.

news.headline: A judge turns down the SEC in its fight with LSU
news.summary: A federal judge said no to the league's request for an emergency order against LSU. The SEC's school presidents still plan to meet on December 3 and vote on whether to put LSU out of the conference.

news.headline: The SEC will vote next week on removing LSU
news.summary: The conference has sued LSU over players it tried to put on its rosters after those players had signed professional contracts, and its schools will meet December 3 to vote on whether LSU can stay in the SEC. LSU asked a judge Tuesday to throw the lawsuit out.

The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge, so it plays in the ESPN app instead of the channel list. It is the last game of the regular season. Tulane beat North Texas on Saturday to reach six wins and five losses, so the Green Wave is going to a bowl game. South Florida has won six games and lost five.

news.headline: Tulane coach Chris Forestier up for a national award
news.summary: Forestier runs Tulane's kicking and punting teams, and he is one of 60 assistant coaches in the country nominated for the Broyles Award. Tulane has blocked four kicks this season, more than any other team in its league.

news.headline: Trace Johnson honored for his four touchdown passes
news.summary: The American Conference put the freshman quarterback on its weekly honor roll Monday. He completed 17 of his 21 throws for 283 yards and four touchdowns in Saturday's comeback win over North Texas.

news.headline: Tulane beats North Texas 28-24 and makes a bowl
news.summary: Trace Johnson threw four touchdown passes, and the last one, to Cameron Roberts with 2:13 left, put Tulane ahead for the first time. The Green Wave has won six games and lost five and is going to a bowl game for the fifth year in a row.

nextGame.note: Semifinal of the state playoffs, Friday in Alexandria. The kickoff time has not been announced yet. It is a long drive — Alexandria is in the middle of the state, about three and a half hours from New Orleans. Brother Martin has won nine games and lost three after upsetting St. Augustine 28-27. Alexandria has won eleven games and lost one. The winner plays for the state title at the Superdome on Saturday, December 12, at noon.

news.headline: Brother Martin upsets St. Augustine 28-27
news.summary: The Crusaders beat the top-seeded Purple Knights on Friday night at Tad Gormley Stadium. St. Augustine scored late and went for two points to win instead of kicking the tie, and Brother Martin knocked the pass down.

news.headline: Easton Royal runs for 221 yards and three scores
news.summary: Royal carried the ball 23 times against St. Augustine, including a 77-yard run that put Brother Martin ahead. The Crusaders are one win from playing for the state title.

news.headline: Brother Martin runs past Bonnabel 56-9
news.summary: The Crusaders won Friday night at Tad Gormley Stadium and are into the state quarterfinals. They have now won eight games and lost three.
